ValidationRule.description: #27029 : When Opp is created with type of UpSell then Account Hierarchy level = "Country Parent" OR "Parent HQ" OR "Sales (Site)"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.Disable_VR__c && OR(ISBLANK($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c), CONTAINS($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c, 'Opportunity'))),
ISPICKVAL(Type , 'Up-Sell/Lift'), OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(AccountId) ),
NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL(Account.IM_Hierarchy_Level__c ,'Sales (Site)'), ISPICKVAL(Account.IM_Hierarchy_Level__c ,'Country Parent'), ISPICKVAL(Account.IM_Hierarchy_Level__c ,'Parent HQ') ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select an Account w/ Hierarchy Level = Sales (Site), Country Parent or Parent HQ for your Opportunity. Need help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
